QuestInfo.name: Curse Your Human Legs
QuestInfo.1: Moonbeam started to scold you for being so slow, even though she was the one scrambling. She figures you can find the way yourself. Gee, thanks. Follow her through the portal on the right.
QuestInfo.2: You arrived at Fox Point Village. Everyone has huge ears and tails, they call themselves the Pointy-Ear Foxes, and there are two moons in the sky. Where in the world are you?
